info.title: MedCredix API
info.description:
API documentation for MedCredix.

### Getting started
1. Open **auth → POST /api/auth** and click **Try it out**.
2. Enter an account email and the password `MedCredixTest26`, then click **Execute**.
3. The token is applied to **Authorize** automatically. To set it by hand, click **Authorize** and enter `Bearer <token>`.
4. Open any other endpoint, click **Try it out**, fill in the parameters, then click **Execute**.
5. To switch role, sign in again with another account. To sign out, call **POST /api/auth/logout**.

### Test accounts
| No | Email | Password | Role | Hospital |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | superadmin@spkd.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Super Admin | All hospitals |
| 2 | auditorbpjs@spkd.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | BPJS Auditor | All hospitals |
| 3 | admin@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Hospital Admin | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 4 | manajemen@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Hospital Management | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 5 | kredensial@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Credential Officer | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 6 | komite@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Medical Committee | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 7 | sdm@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | HR | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 8 | auditor@spkd.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Auditor | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 9 | klaim@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Claims Team | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 10 | it@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | IT SIMRS | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 11 | viewer@nusantarasehat.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Viewer | RS Nusantara Sehat |
| 12 | admin@medikasejahtera.co.id | MedCredixTest26 | Hospital Admin | RS Medika Sejahtera |

Super Admin and BPJS Auditor must fill `hospitalId` (`h_nusantara` or `h_medika`) on hospital data endpoints.

### Response format
| Result | Body |
|---|---|
| Success | `{"ok": true, "data": ...}` |
| Error | `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}` |

### Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 400 | Invalid input |
| 401 | Not signed in, or token expired / revoked |
| 403 | No permission, or another hospital's data |
| 404 | Not found |
| 409 | Status conflict |
| 413 | File too large (max 5 MB) |
| 429 | Too many failed sign in attempts |

### Notes
- There is no DELETE endpoint. Records are closed or deactivated with PATCH.
- POST and PATCH change real data in the running database.

patch.description:
Runs one step. The current status is validated, steps cannot be skipped.

| action | From | To | Permission |
|---|---|---|---|
| submit | segera_berakhir, kedaluwarsa | diajukan | EDIT |
| verify | diajukan | verifikasi | VERIFY |
| review | verifikasi | tinjauan_komite | VERIFY |
| approve | tinjauan_komite | disetujui | APPROVE |
| activate | disetujui | aktif (version +1) | APPROVE |
| reject | tinjauan_komite | ditangguhkan | APPROVE |
| suspend | aktif, segera_berakhir | ditangguhkan | APPROVE |
| reactivate | ditangguhkan | aktif | APPROVE |

**Permission:** EDIT, VERIFY or APPROVE depending on the step

action.description: submit, verify, review, approve, activate, reject, suspend or reactivate

400.description: id and action are required, or unknown action

403.description: Role does not have the required permission

409.description: Step not allowed from the current status
